# Privacy Policy for FkAd

**Effective Date: August 13, 2026**

Thank you for choosing FkAd. We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring that your personal data remains completely secure. This Privacy Policy explains how FkAd operates and why your privacy is guaranteed when using our application.

## 1. No Data Collection
FkAd is designed with a strict **Zero Data Collection** policy. 
- We **do not** collect, log, store, or share any of your personal information, browsing history, DNS queries, IP addresses, or network traffic.
- We **do not** require you to create an account, register, or provide any personal details to use our app.

## 2. How Our Local Proxy (Network Extension) Works
FkAd utilizes Apple's official Network Extension framework to create a **local VPN** on your device. 
- This VPN operates entirely **on your device (locally)** and does not route your internet traffic through any external or remote servers.
- The sole purpose of this local proxy is to filter web requests and block trackers based on the ad-blocking rules you import.
- Because all filtering is processed locally, your network data never leaves your device.

## 3. Third-Party Rules and Configurations
FkAd allows you to import custom filtering configurations (e.g., from open-source GitHub repositories). Please note that while FkAd itself does not collect any data, the effectiveness of the filtering depends on the rules you choose to import. We do not control and are not responsible for the content of third-party rules.

## 4. Crash Logs and Analytics
We do not integrate any third-party tracking SDKs or analytics tools into FkAd. The only data we may receive is the anonymous crash logs provided voluntarily by Apple (if you have opted-in to share crash data with developers in your iOS settings). These logs contain no personally identifiable information and are strictly used to improve the stability of the app.

## 5. Changes to This Privacy Policy
We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page. We advise you to review this page periodically for any changes. 

## 6. Contact Us
If you have any questions or suggestions about our Privacy Policy, please do not hesitate to contact us at:
